build_pipeline_with_fraction_failure_thr: build a SPDL pipeline using PipelineBuilder with a Fraction-based max_failures threshold to auto-stop on high failure rates
test_pipeline_failure_rate_exceeds_thres: test that a SPDL pipeline raises PipelineFailure when the actual failure rate exceeds the Fraction threshold after probation
test_pipeline_failure_rate_under_thresho: test that a SPDL pipeline succeeds when the actual failure rate stays below the Fraction threshold
test_pipeline_per_pipe_failure_override: test that a per-pipe max_failures Fraction override takes precedence over the global pipeline threshold
test_pipeline_probation_period_behavior: test that the fixed probation period of 100 invocations prevents early false positives on small datasets
